candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance so deposits no longer increase Acc[msg.sender].balance.
Set acc.unlockTime directly to _unlockTime instead of clamping it to at least the current block timestamp.
Remove the 'locked_ = false;' reset at the end of the nonReentrant_ modifier so locked_ stays true and all subsequent Put calls revert.
Delete the statement that subtracts the withdrawn amount from the account balance, so acc.balance stays unchanged after a successful withdrawal.
Replace the balance subtraction with an addition so the account balance increases by the withdrawn amount instead of decreasing.
Remove the `acc.balance>=_am` check from the guard so withdrawals larger than the balance can be attempted.
Remove the unlock-time check from the guard so funds can be collected before the unlock time.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful withdrawals are no longer recorded in the log.
Delete the `locked_ = false;` statement after `_;` so the reentrancy lock is never released and any subsequent transaction reverts.
